title: Split Strings by Separator
summary: Given an array of strings and a character separator, split each string by the separator.
statement: Given an array of strings and a character separator, split each string by the separator. Return an array of non-empty strings in their original order, excluding the separator.
constraints: Split each word wherever the one-character separator occurs.
Discard empty pieces caused by leading, trailing, or consecutive separators.
Preserve word order and piece order.
reference_solution:
def split_words_by_separator(words,separator):
    return [piece for word in words for piece in word.split(separator) if piece]
hints: Process input words from left to right.
Split each with the given literal character and filter empty strings.
Flatten the remaining pieces in comprehension order.
The language split operation identifies every separator boundary, while filtering implements the explicit empty-piece rule.
